description: Look up several 311 service requests by their 311 numbers in one call. Each comes back as in get_service_request, with its plain_language block; numbers the API did not find are listed in not_found (the API leaves them out without an error). Duplicates are dropped; the server sends 20 at a time, one batch after another, for at most 45 seconds. A failed batch, a 429 or running out of time stops it: the answer keeps what was found and lists not_looked_up.

sr_numbers.description: Service request numbers, up to 200 different ones, e.g. ['311-17323508', '311-17323514']

name: get_service_request_list
